tools.name: minerva_obs_controller_connect
tools.description: Connect to OBS WebSocket server. Defaults to localhost:4455.

password.description: OBS WebSocket password (leave empty if authentication is disabled)

tools.name: minerva_obs_controller_disconnect
tools.description: Disconnect from the OBS WebSocket server.

tools.name: minerva_obs_controller_get_status
tools.description: Get current OBS connection status and scene info. Always works, even when disconnected.

tools.name: minerva_obs_controller_list_scenes
tools.description: List all scenes in OBS and identify the current program scene.

tools.name: minerva_obs_controller_switch_scene
tools.description: Switch the current OBS program scene.

scene.description: Name of the scene to switch to

tools.name: minerva_obs_controller_set_camera_position
tools.description: Position the webcam overlay using a semantic 3x3 grid. Row: top/middle/bottom, Column: left/center/right, Size: small/medium/large.

tools.name: minerva_obs_controller_list_sources
tools.description: List all sources in the current OBS scene. Use this to discover the webcam source name for camera positioning.

tools.name: minerva_obs_controller_stop_recording
tools.description: Stop OBS recording and return the output file path.

tools.name: minerva_obs_controller_list_recordings
tools.description: List video recordings in the OBS output directory, sorted by newest first.

tools.name: minerva_obs_controller_configure
tools.description: Set OBS connection details, webcam source name, and output directory. Saved to disk for persistence.

camera_source.description: Name of the webcam source in OBS

auto_connect.description: Auto-connect to OBS on plugin start
